hypotheses.M1_sixteen_prototypes_cover_local_subspa: An oracle over 16 rank-four prototypes captures at least 50% of local optimal rank-four Fisher energy on every corpus.
hypotheses.M2_state_router_recovers_prototype: Nearest state-centroid routing captures at least 40% of local optimal rank-four Fisher energy on every corpus.
hypotheses.M3_routed_prototype_has_finite_causal_fi: The routed 16-prototype direction has median finite Fisher fidelity at least 0.50 to the local leading direction on every corpus.
hypotheses.M4_quantization_beats_single_global_spac: Sixteen-prototype routed capture is at least twice the one-prototype capture on every corpus.
hypotheses.M5_middle_conditional_code_transfers_ood: Routed 16-prototype capture drops by at most 0.15 from FineWeb to either OOD corpus.
hypotheses.M6_state_router_matches_oracle_cluster: The state-centroid router selects the oracle-capture prototype on at least 40% of sites on every corpus.
